feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $T$ and the vector $v$ given below. If $T$ is the standard matrix of the linear transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{3},$ find $T(v).$

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -5\end{aligned}],\,v=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the fact that $\,T(v)=T\cdot v,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}T(v) & =T\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-4 & 2 \\ 2 & 1 \\ 3 & -5\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}2 \\ 3\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 7 \\ -9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
